claims: Charlie Woods is the son of Tiger Woods.
Charlie Woods is the son of Elin Nordegren.
As of February 2026, Charlie Woods has committed to play golf for Florida State University for the 2027 recruiting class.
Charlie Woods verbally committed to Florida State University in February 2026.
Charlie Woods has won high school state championships at The Benjamin School in Florida.
Charlie Woods has played in the PNC Championship multiple times with his father.
Charlie Woods achieved a hole-in-one in competition in 2024.
